parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no structural evidence whatsoever: members is an empty array, and all structural_evidence fields (differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, shared_field_count) are null. Without field lists, method signatures, or any overlap metrics for MetalWallpaperView and MetalWallpaperRenderer, there is no grounded basis on which to recommend a refactor. The two types in Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Renderers/ are architecturally distinct by name — a view and a renderer — and their co-location in the same Renderers/ directory is expected rather than suspicious.
